key_prefix.doc: Room key prefix for generated cells.

wilderness.doc: Default wilderness flag for generated cells.

outdoor.doc: Default outdoor flag for generated cells.

route_kind.doc: How road_rows paint: interstate gold (default) or wagon ruts.

zone.doc: Default Cadence zone id for cells.

terrain_rows.doc: Compact atlas: height strings of width terrain glyphs (y=0 south). Space void, ~ ocean, o lake, . plains, ^ mountains, T forest, ' wetland, , desert. Named mouths stay in cell_overrides.

water_view_rows.doc: HUD-only water paint on America void margins (earth_america). Height strings of width glyphs (y=0 south): ~ ocean-view, o lake-view, space none. Cosmetic minimap tint only — does not change sim area_type when terrain is void and does not create walkable ocean on America. Great Lakes follow shore rings, not a lat/lon rectangle.

land_view_rows.doc: HUD-only Canada land paint on America void margins (earth_america). Height strings of width glyphs (y=0 south): T timber, . prairie, space none. Cosmetic only — sim stays void. Sibling earth_canada.json holds real Canada grid coords for a later hop.

river_rows.doc: Inland river overlay on land atlases. Height strings of width glyphs (y=0 south); space none. Does not replace land area_type; expand may set map_glyph and fishing tags later.

road_rows.doc: Compact atlas: matching route overlay (= | / \ + or space). grid.route_kind trail paints wagon ruts (not interstate gold). City letters still win via cell_overrides map_glyph.

highland_rows.doc: Compact atlas: matching mining-country mask (H or space). Visual biome stays in terrain_rows; only ridge cells are mountains. Room.highland + mine mouths follow this flag.

depth_rows.doc: Water maps only (earth_gulf, earth_great_lakes, future offshore ids). Height strings of width chars (y=0 south): one digit or char per cell for max depth band index (0/1/2). Lakes: surface|mid|lakebed. Offshore: inshore|slope|abyss. Consumed by water endurance (PR 2).

cell_overrides.doc: Per-cell override map keyed by x,y. Sparse on layer atlases (cities, dungeon mouths); full paint when terrain_rows is omitted.

portals.doc: Legacy grid portal pairs (prefer pockets[] on overland maps).
